subject: DI01000091

body.en:
Understand the idea

Structured programming divides work into clear sequences,decisions,loops and named procedures.

Explanation and application

  • Create a My Blocks custom block such as draw polygon(sides,length),define its body and call it with arguments.The caller supplies values;names alone do not execute a procedure.
  • A parameter is a named input of the procedure;an argument is a value/expression supplied by a call.Use parameters instead of unexplained shared variables where appropriate.
  • Recursion calls the procedure itself and requires a base case plus progress.Countdown(n):if n>0,say n and call Countdown(n−1);otherwise stop recursing.
  • Test n=0 and a small positive value;unbounded recursion can hang or exhaust resources.Do not choose run without screen refresh for uncontrolled long loops.

Download custom-block recursion .sb3

What prevents infinite recursion?

A reachable base case and progress toward it.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Structured programming કામને clear sequence,decisions,loops તથા named proceduresમાં વહેંચે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • My Blocksમાં draw polygon(sides,length) બનાવો,body define કરીને argumentsથી call કરો.Caller values આપે છે;નામથી જ procedure execute થતી નથી.
  • Parameter procedureનો named input છે;argument callથી મળતી value/expression છે.યોગ્ય હોય ત્યાં unexplained shared globalsને બદલે parameters લો.
  • Recursionમાં procedure પોતાને call કરે છે.Base case તથા progress જરૂરી છે.Countdown(n):n>0 હોય તો n કહો તથા Countdown(n−1)call કરો,નહિતર recursion રોકો.
  • n=0 તથા small positive value test કરો.Unbounded recursion hang/resources exhaust કરી શકે.Uncontrolled long loops માટે run without screen refresh ન લો.

Download custom-block recursion .sb3

Infinite Recursion શું અટકાવે?

Reachable base case તથા તેના તરફ progress.

Understand the idea

An event hat starts a matching script;several handlers can run concurrently.

Explanation and application

  • when key pressed and when this sprite clicked respond to input;the project must be focused for expected key interaction.
  • broadcast sends a named message;when I receive starts matching handlers.The message name is an event label,not the text spoken by say.
  • broadcast and wait waits for matching receivers to finish;receivers containing forever may prevent the sender from continuing.
  • Initialise shared state before broadcasting and avoid multiple scripts overwriting the same variable unexpectedly.

વિચાર સમજીએ

Event hat matching script શરૂ કરે છે;અનેક handlers concurrently ચાલી શકે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • when key pressed તથા when this sprite clicked inputનો પ્રતિસાદ આપે છે.Expected key interaction માટે project focused હોવો જોઈએ.
  • broadcast named message મોકલે છે;when I receive matching handlers ચલાવે છે.Message event label છે,sayનું spoken text નહિ.
  • broadcast and wait receivers પૂરા થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાહ જુએ છે.Foreverવાળા receivers senderને આગળ વધવા ન દે.

Understand the idea

Less than,greater than and equal to return Boolean conditions rather than display commands.

Explanation and application

  • Check equality and ties explicitly;largest-of-three can initialise max to the first value and update only for a strictly larger value.
  • To express <=,use not(a>b);to express >=,use not(a<b) when the values are validated numbers.
  • Scratch equality is not strict case-sensitive string identity;numeric-looking strings can compare numerically.Test your chosen text/number interpretation.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Less than,greater than/equal to Boolean conditions આપે છે,display commands નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Equality/ties તપાસો.Largest-of-threeમાં max પહેલી valueથી initialise કરીને strictly larger પર update કરી શકાય.
  • Validated numbers માટે <=ને not(a>b) તથા >=ને not(a<b)થી દર્શાવી શકાય.
  • Scratch equality strict case-sensitive string identity નથી.Numeric-looking strings numerically compare થઈ શકે.Chosen interpretation test કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Logical operators combine/invert Boolean results;truth conditions must match the intended rule.

Explanation and application

  • and needs both true;or needs at least one true;not reverses true/false.Parenthesise/nest deliberately.
  • Valid range can be not(x<low) and not(x>high);outside is (x<low) or (x>high),not an and between impossible extremes.
  • Test all true/false combinations and exact boundary values;do not rely only on one convenient example.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Logical operators Boolean results combine/invert કરે છે.Truth conditions intended rule મુજબ હોવી જોઈએ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • andમાં બંને true;orમાં ઓછામાં ઓછું એક true;not true/false ઉલટાવે છે.Nesting વિચારીને કરો.
  • Valid range not(x<low) and not(x>high) છે.Outside (x<low) or (x>high) છે,impossible extremes વચ્ચે and નહિ.
  • બધા true/false combinations તથા exact boundaries test કરો.એક convenient example ઉપર જ આધાર ન રાખો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Choose control according to whether time,an event,a count or a condition ends the action.

Explanation and application

  • wait pauses for a duration;repeat runs a count;forever repeats until a stop mechanism intervenes.
  • if executes a true branch;if-else chooses one of two branches.Increment counters in the correct place to ensure progress.
  • wait until pauses until a condition is true;repeat until checks before each iteration and can execute zero times.
  • stop this script differs from stop all;choose scope deliberately so a helper does not unexpectedly kill the entire project.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Time,event,count કે conditionમાંથી શું action પૂરી કરે તે મુજબ control પસંદ કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • wait duration માટે pause કરે;repeat count મુજબ તથા forever stop mechanism આવે ત્યાં સુધી ચાલે.
  • if true branch ચલાવે;if-else બે branchesમાંથી એક પસંદ કરે.Counters યોગ્ય જગ્યાએ update કરો.
  • wait until condition true થાય ત્યાં સુધી pause કરે;repeat until દરેક iteration પહેલાં check કરતાં zero times પણ ચાલી શકે.
  • stop this script તથા stop all જુદાં છે.Scope જાણીને પસંદ કરો જેથી helper આખો project બંધ ન કરી દે.

Understand the idea

A list is an ordered collection;positions start at1 in Scratch.

Explanation and application

  • Create/reset a list.Add appends;delete removes;insert shifts items;replace changes an existing value without adding a position.
  • item i of list accesses a valid position;length counts items;contains asks membership,not the first matching position or occurrence count.
  • For maximum,initialise from the first item,not zero,so all-negative lists work.For average,guard the empty list before division.
  • Linear search checks items in order and can stop at the first match.Counting occurrences must scan the entire list,including duplicates.
  • Bubble sort compares adjacent numeric items and swaps out-of-order pairs with a temporary variable;reduce the inner bound after each pass.
  • Validate numeric lists before arithmetic/sorting;empty and single-item lists are valid edge cases,not reasons to access item0.
How do contains and count differ?

Membership is true/false;counting scans for all occurrences.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

List ordered collection છે.Scratchમાં positions1થી શરૂ થાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • List create/reset કરો.Add append કરે;delete remove કરે;insert shift કરે;replace position ઉમેર્યા વગર value બદલે છે.
  • item i valid position access કરે;length items ગણે;contains membership છે,first index/occurrence count નહિ.
  • Maximum first itemથી initialise કરો,zeroથી નહિ,જેથી all-negative list પણ સાચી પડે.Average પહેલાં empty list guard કરો.
  • Linear search ordered items તપાસીને first matchએ રોકાઈ શકે.Occurrence count માટે duplicates સહિત આખી list scan થાય.
  • Bubble sort adjacent numeric items compare કરીને temp variableથી swap કરે છે.દરેક pass પછી inner bound ઘટાડો.
  • Arithmetic/sorting પહેલાં numeric list validate કરો.Empty/single-item lists valid edge cases છે,item0 access કરવાનો આધાર નહિ.
contains તથા countમાં ભેદ?

Membership true/false છે;counting બધા occurrences ગણે છે.

Aim and source duration

  4. Press green flag and enter only the planned test inputs;stop the project if behaviour is unexpected.
  5. 2and97prime;1,9and negative integers not prime.Reject fractional input.
  6. Repeat with a boundary/invalid case and a second fresh run.Save the editable project and actual evidence,not prefilled execution claims.
